summary: The Antrag auf Kindergeld (form KG 1) is the paper application for Germany’s child benefit, sent with one Anlage Kind for each child to the Familienkasse of the Federal Employment Agency. You fill it in if you live in Germany (or are fully taxable there) and a child under 18, or an older child in training, lives with you; only one person receives Kindergeld for each child.
